About the job: 
 We are seeking for a Software Developer / Software Engineer with strong hands-on experience in Perl, Python, and JavaScript. The candidate should have experience in Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban), Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines, software architecture, and REST API development and integration.
 Mandatory Skills: 
Programming Languages: Strong expertise in Perl, Python, and JavaScript; ability to write clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
Agile Development: Knowledge of Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban, and iterative software development practices.
Version Control & CI/CD: Hands-on experience with Git, GitHub/GitLab, version control workflows, and CI/CD pipeline implementation.
Software Architecture: Understanding of software architecture, design patterns, modular architecture, and service-oriented architecture (SOA).
REST APIs & Web Services: Experience developing and integrating RESTful APIs, with knowledge of HTTP/HTTPS, OpenAPI, and Swagger.
Cloud-Native Technologies: Experience with microservices architecture, Docker containerization, and Kubernetes orchestration.
 Nice-to-Have Skills: 
Quality Engineering & Testing: Knowledge of test strategy design and implementation, including unit, integration, system, functional, non-functional, and regression testing.
Operating Systems: Strong experience working in Linux environments; Windows knowledge is an advantage.
Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong logical thinking, analytical abilities, attention to detail, and troubleshooting skills.
Customer Focus: Commitment to delivering high-quality, reliable, and customer-oriented software solutions.
Communication & Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with international, cross-functional, and distributed teams.
English Proficiency: Good spoken and written English communication skills.
 About Us: 
 Ascendion is a global, leading provider of AI firstsoftware engineering services, delivering transformative solutions across North America, APAC, and Europe. We are headquartered in New Jersey. We combine technology and talent to deliver tech debt relief, improve engineering productivity solutions, and accelerate time to value, driving our clients’ digital journeys with efficiency and velocity. Guided by our “Engineering to the power of AI” [EngineeringAI] methodology, we integrate AI into software engineering, enterprise operations, and talent orchestration, to address critical challenges of trust, speed, and capital. For more information, please go to www.ascendion.com 
 With Ascendion (www.ascendion.com), you:
Will get to work on numerous challenging and exciting projects on our various offerings including Salesforce, AI/Data Science, Generative AI/ML, Automation, Cloud Enterprise and Product/Platform Engineering.
At Ascendion you have high chances of project extension or redeployment to other clients.
Additionally, you can also share CV of anyone you know. We have a referral policy in place.
